goals.statement: On each seed `first-run`, `agents-10`, `tree-40`, `daemon-exits` and `conflict` (U26), `window.__checks()` (U137) gives `status: "pass"` for every check from D1 to D10. A `u136_` test on main asserts this for each seed.
goals.observer: Driver/QA: run the `u136_` test on main's head and evaluate `window.__checks()` in the harness on each of the five seeds; retain the output and the run URL.

goals.statement: `u130_` to `u135_` all pass on main for those five seeds.
goals.observer: QA: run `pnpm --filter desktop test` limited to `u130_`–`u135_` on main's head; retain the output and the run URL.

goals.statement: The critic's Baseline protocol (`docs/design-system.md`) captures `origin/main` before the visual pass and main after it, on the same seed, viewport, colour scheme and clock. `loop/rules.sh delta` reports each of D1–D10 as `fixed` (or `still-passing` where it already passed) and reports none as `regressed`, on all five seeds.
goals.observer: Design critic: `loop/rules.sh delta` output for each seed, with captures retained at an HTTPS run/artifact URL.
